title: Browser seam contracts for the Lineage UI

claims.text: contracts.ts defines JsonValue, JsonObject, ScreenId, ScreenModuleId, EntityKind, Theme, Query and Route as the passive public browser seam, with the server owning all decisions.
The Transport interface exposes mode, fixtureId, presentation, tools, events and call, and AppStore plus AppState carry phase, stale, route, tools, events, head, error, selection and expanded.
The file fixes the closed K0 action vocabulary in the actions set and the panelStates, entityKinds and screenLabels tables that name every screen and panel state.
WireReply is exactly {untrusted:T} on success or {ok:false,code,detail} on domain failure, and LedgerEvent carries the lineage.event/v1 hash-chain fields.

decision.rule: Change here when the browser seam types, the closed action vocabulary, or the fixed screen and panel inventories need to change.
decision.failure: A screen references an action outside the closed set, a wire reply fails validation, or a screen has no label in screenLabels.

questions.q: Where is the closed list of UI action names defined for the shell and screens?
Where should I change the Transport interface to add a new transport method?
Where can I debug why a tool call reply is rejected as invalid_response?
Which screens does screenLabels cover and what are their titles?
